newsitem.title: GERMANY: Sommers happy with D.Telekom stock price.
newsitem.headline: Sommers happy with D.Telekom stock price.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG chairman Ron Sommer said he finds the company's current stock price very satisfactory and that the development since the November listing has been good.
Sommer told a group of journalists late on Tuesday that he could see no selling pressure on the stock and that the majority of shareholders apparently see it as a longer-term investment.
The current price shows that the initial offering price of 28.50 marks ($17.05) was well chosen, he said.

Deutsche Telekom shares moved up to 32.20 marks in computer trade before the opening on Wednesday after closing Tuesday trade on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange at 31.97 marks, up 27 pfennigs on the day.
The stock's high of 34.20 marks was set on November 18.
